practical-ndt.name: Practical NDT: browser-based NDT training simulator
practical-ndt.description: A 33-second look at Practical NDT, captured from the simulator itself: choosing a training environment, guided UT practicals with a procedure checklist, PAUT and radiography bench practicals, eddy current tube inspection on a heat exchanger, MFL tank-floor practice with a C-scan map and UT on an offshore wind platform. Runs in the browser and sits inside the Atlantis LMS and ERP. A practice and training tool, not a validated engineering tool.
practical-ndt.heading: See Practical NDT in 30 seconds

trailer.name: Atlantis NDT: ERP, digital twin reporting, NDT simulation, training and Level III
trailer.description: A short tour of Atlantis NDT: the ERP workflow configurator, a sample digital twin inspection report, the browser-based ultrasonic A-scan demo, NDT training pathways, Level III consulting and the inspection quotation form. Digital twin data shown is labelled sample data.
trailer.heading: See Atlantis NDT in 30 seconds
